steps.speaker: FAC Alert
steps.content: BR-002's afterimage is expanding abnormally. Highly contaminated crystalline substances are occurring, producing a massive amount of Mania radiation confirmed to significantly affect the surrounding civilians.

steps.speaker: FAC Alert
steps.content: Currently, the civilian forces of West District are assisting in evacuating the population, but the threat remains.

steps.speaker: FAC Alert
steps.content: The Sun Crow Apostle is possibly reaching the crowd through radiation to gain power by absorbing Mania. Please stop it as soon as possible!
The sudden disaster has caught West District off guard. People who are mildly infected with Mania are subject to stronger radiation, which drags them into fear, despair, and even madness.
The Executive Committee is aiding the evacuation, but not enough Executive Officers can be deployed within such a short time, so the people are mostly left to their own devices.
And in this process, more and more people are affected.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: ...Ugh, so hot. My head hurts... Why do I hear birds chirping in my head?

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Our Black Ring is in trouble again? Have ${PlayerName} and Yanyan come back?
He supports himself with the wall and walks outside, then looks up to see the afterimage of the collapsed High Tower Black Ring gradually expanding and branching out.
He can clearly see the branch producing a strange crystal, very similar to what Yanyan and ${PlayerName} were carefully collecting.
The entire afterimage of the Black Ring looks like a sky-reaching tree or a terrifying antenna, visible to every West District resident.
